notes: Snapshot: building IntelliJ/PyCharm plugin that provides local index + streaming code completions; primary differentiator = on-device indexed search to reduce token cost and latency.
Customer quote: "If completions are >100ms dev adoption tanked" — CTO (Rina Kapoor)
Workload: monorepo (Java + Kotlin + Python) with large codebase (~45M LOC). Need incremental local indexing and delta uploads only for hosted fallback.
Primary requirements: <100ms single-line latency (local), 200 reqs/min throughput for shared team server, model pinning per-plugin-version, deterministic completions for CI reruns.
Deployment preferences: local on-prem indexer wrapped in plugin; fallback to Redwood hosted/dedicated for heavy-weight generation. VPC networking for telemetry and audit logs.
Security asks: SSO/SAML for admin console, audit logs retention 1 year, optional KMS for any persisted keys, GDPR residency EU for EU customers.
Engineering notes from call: care about kernel selection and quantized model variants for x86_64 Linux and Windows. Windows binary size must stay under 80MB to ship via JetBrains plugin marketplace.

POC scope: 1) local incremental indexer running as background process, 2) streaming completion integration with IntelliJ editor (non-blocking), 3) model pin + fallback routing test (hosted -> dedicated).
Success criteria: latency <100ms local for single token, 95th pct <250ms for multi-token completions in normal IDE session, cost per dev < $5/month at scale target (200 devs).

Integration concerns: JetBrains plugin lifecycle (updates, background indexing), user consent for optional telemetry, per-workspace index encryption.
Commercial: evaluating Dedicated reserved capacity for Q3 internal rollout. Also interested in Optimize feature for cost suggestions during POC.
